source: Phase24 loss-archetype report; no new replay or post-entry labeling performed here.

methodology.purpose: Decompose the Phase25 D-vs-non-D family separation into individual pre-entry features.
methodology.target: LOSS_D_PRE_GE_2R versus all other losing archetypes.
methodology.metric: One-vs-rest AUC where AUC > 0.5 means the feature is higher in D and AUC < 0.5 means lower in D.
methodology.validation: Each feature is audited overall and separately in DEV, VAL, BUY, SELL, LONDON, NEW_YORK and OUT_OF_SESSION. DEV/VAL direction agreement is reported descriptively.
methodology.redundancy: Within-family pairwise Spearman correlation is reported to identify features carrying overlapping information.

interpretationGuard.note: This is a descriptive decomposition, not a filter-selection study. A feature being separated does not authorize a threshold or production rule.
